passages.text: When Jeremiah had finished telling all the people all the words of the LORD their God—everything that the LORD had sent him to say— Azariah son of Hoshaiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, “You are lying! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to reside there.’
passages.sermon:
Jeremiah was a prophet.
The LORD was the God of the people.
The LORD sent Jeremiah to speak to the people.
Jeremiah finished telling all the people every word from the LORD their God.
He spoke everything the LORD had sent him to say.
Azariah son of Hoshaiah was among the people.
Johanan son of Kareah was also among the people.
There were other men who were arrogant.
Azariah, Johanan, and all the arrogant men spoke to Jeremiah.
They said to Jeremiah, “You are lying.”
They said, “The LORD our God has not sent you.”
They said, “The LORD did not tell you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to live there.’”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְּכַלּ֨וֹת יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר שְׁלָח֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֲזַרְיָ֤ה בֶן־ הוֹשַֽׁעְיָה֙ וְיוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ וְכָל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַזֵּדִ֑ים אֹמְרִ֣ים אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שֶׁ֚קֶר אַתָּ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר לֹ֣א שְׁלָחֲךָ֞ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ תָבֹ֥אוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָג֥וּר שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans, so that they may put us to death or exile us to Babylon!”
passages.sermon:
Baruch is the son of Neriah.
Baruch is influencing you against us.
Baruch wants you to hand us over to the Chaldeans.
The Chaldeans may kill us.
The Chaldeans may take us away to Babylon.
passages.original: כִּ֗י בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן־ נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה מַסִּ֥ית אֹתְךָ֖ בָּ֑נוּ לְמַעַן֩ תֵּ֨ת אֹתָ֤נוּ בְיַֽד־ הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ לְהָמִ֣ית אֹתָ֔נוּ וּלְהַגְל֥וֹת אֹתָ֖נוּ בָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces disobeyed the command of the LORD to stay in the land of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Johanan was the son of Kareah.
He was a leader among the people.
There were also commanders of the army with him.
All the people were with them.
The LORD gave a command.
The LORD told them to stay in the land of Judah.
Johanan, the commanders, and all the people did not obey the LORD.
They refused to stay in Judah.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַע֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֜חַ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲיָלִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the whole remnant of Judah, those who had returned to the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been scattered, the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and everyone whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had allowed to remain with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
passages.sermon:
Johanan was the son of Kareah.
He led the group.
All the commanders of the forces joined him.
They took the whole remnant of Judah.
These people had returned to Judah from many nations.
They had been scattered among those nations.
The group included men.
The group included women.
The group included children.
The group included the king’s daughters.
Nebuzaradan was the captain of the guard.
He had allowed some people to remain with Gedaliah.
Gedaliah was the son of Ahikam.
Ahikam was the son of Shaphan.
Johanan and the commanders took all these people.
They also took Jeremiah the prophet.
They also took Baruch son of Neriah.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יוֹחָנָ֤ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֙חַ֙ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַחֲיָלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֗בוּ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ־ שָׁ֔ם לָג֖וּר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃ אֶֽת־ הַ֠גְּבָרִים וְאֶת־ הַנָּשִׁ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַטַּף֮ וְאֶת־ בְּנ֣וֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנִּ֙יחַ֙ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב־ טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת־ גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא וְאֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: So they entered the land of Egypt because they did not obey the voice of the LORD, and they went as far as Tahpanhes.
passages.sermon:
Johanan son of Kareah led the people.
The commanders of the forces went with him.
They took all the remnant of Judah.
They did not obey the voice of the LORD.
They entered the land of Egypt.
They traveled as far as Tahpanhes.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ תַּחְפַּנְחֵֽס׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes: “In the sight of the Jews, pick up some large stones and bury them in the clay of the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace at Tahpanhes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes.
Jeremiah was a prophet.
God gave Jeremiah a command.
God told Jeremiah to pick up some large stones.
God told Jeremiah to bury the stones in the clay.
The clay was in the brick pavement.
The brick pavement was at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace.
This palace was in Tahpanhes.
God told Jeremiah to do this where the Jews could see him.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בְּתַחְפַּנְחֵ֖ס לֵאמֹֽר׃ קַ֣ח בְּיָדְךָ֞ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֗וֹת וּטְמַנְתָּ֤ם בַּמֶּ֙לֶט֙ בַּמַּלְבֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּפֶ֥תַח בֵּית־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה בְּתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס לְעֵינֵ֖י אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יְהוּדִֽים׃

passages.text: Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks with authority.
He commands Jeremiah to speak to the people.
The LORD says, “I will act now.
I will send Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
He is My servant.
I will bring Nebuchadnezzar here.
I will set his throne above these stones.
These are the stones you have buried.
I have told you to bury them.
Nebuchadnezzar will spread his royal pavilion over these stones.
He will rule from this place.”
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֡ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵ֙חַ֙ וְ֠לָקַחְתִּי אֶת־ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ עַבְדִּ֔י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י כִסְא֔וֹ מִמַּ֛עַל לָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר טָמָ֑נְתִּי וְנָטָ֥ה אֶת־ שַׁפְרוּרוֹ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He will come and strike down the land of Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
God calls Nebuchadnezzar His servant.
Nebuchadnezzar will come to Egypt.
He will attack the land of Egypt.
Some people in Egypt will die.
These are the people appointed for death.
Some people in Egypt will be taken captive.
These are the people appointed for captivity.
Some people in Egypt will be killed by the sword.
These are the people appointed for the sword.
passages.original: וּבָאָה וְהִכָּ֖ה אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֧ר לַמָּ֣וֶת לַמָּ֗וֶת וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר לַשְּׁבִי֙ לַשֶּׁ֔בִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לַחֶ֖רֶב לֶחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there unscathed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the God of Israel.
He speaks about Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar is called the LORD’s servant.
The LORD says, “I will start a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt.”
Nebuchadnezzar will burn the temples of Egypt’s gods.
Nebuchadnezzar will take the gods of Egypt as captives.
He will cover himself with the land of Egypt like a shepherd covers himself with his garment.
Nebuchadnezzar will leave Egypt safely.
He will not be harmed.
passages.original: וְהִצַּ֣תִּי אֵ֗שׁ בְּבָתֵּי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם וּשְׂרָפָ֖ם וְשָׁבָ֑ם וְעָטָה֩ אֶת־ אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־ יַעְטֶ֤ה הָֽרֹעֶה֙ אֶת־ בִּגְד֔וֹ וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in the land of Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar is the king of Babylon.
He will enter the land of Egypt.
He will break the sacred pillars at the temple of the sun in Egypt.
He will burn the temples of the gods of Egypt with fire.
passages.original: וְשִׁבַּ֗ר אֶֽת־ מַצְּבוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽי־ מִצְרַ֖יִם יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס
